note: A paper record of the desk's readings of the engulf on five markets, buys and sells: the engulf rule on D1, H4 and H1 candles, and three zone methods (the plan with the Daily, the short method in an H4 zone, the direct entry on fresh zones) with a 30-pip stop; the plan and the short method take the target the owner picked for each on the 2026 records (1R; the short method with the next-candle engulf 4R), the direct entry none: its stop is trailed with the 5-minute engulf zones that fail. The plan and the short method are recorded twice, apart: with the engulf that may take an engulf completed within four candles, and with the next-candle engulf only. A fifth reading, apart: inside a 15-minute engulf zone, the most recent one-minute engulf of the other side fails and the entry is that close (the stop past the extreme made since, a 2R target: the desk's own choice). Nothing is traded, results are before costs, and none is a tested rule.
